newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Lion drops rescue of Malaysia steelmaker.
newsitem.headline: Lion drops rescue of Malaysia steelmaker.

text.p: Malaysia's Lion Group of Companies had backed off from a plan to rescue state steelmaker Perwaja Steel Sdn Bhd, Deputy Finance Minister Affifuddin Omar was quoted saying by the national Bernama news agency on Thursday.
Affifuddin said that Lion was no longer involved in the rescue of Perwaja and that Maju needed to consult the government if it decided to make any new appointments in the company.
Lion Corp and Maju Holdings were jointly awarded the rescue of Perwaja, which accumulated debts of 2.9 billion ringgit ($1.16 billion), earlier this year.
But Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim said recently that Lion did not appear satisfied with the 30 percent equity granted to it in the project against Maju's 51 percent.
